facts.text: Tim mentioned that he is currently working on a fantasy novel and finds the process both nerve-wracking and exciting.

evidence.quote: I'm in the middle of fantasy novel and it's a bit nerve-wracking but so exciting!

facts.text: Tim cited books, movies, and real-life experiences as sources of inspiration for his writing, including his interest in castles in the UK.

evidence.quote: Books, movies, and real-life experiences all fire up my creativity. For example, reading about castles in the UK gave me loads of ideas.
I read this awesome book about castles in the UK. It was so interesting and blew me away!

facts.text: Tim identified J.K. Rowling as a particular author whose work inspires him, noting her ability to transport readers into another world through detailed and creative storytelling.

evidence.quote: J.K. Rowling is such an inspiring writer. Her books are so captivating with their detail and creative storytelling. She can definitely transport readers into another world and make them feel so much.
